name: protection_effect_partial_reads
description: Test 27 (PR2), GetStationEffect into a caller record {x 7, z 8, radius 250, centre 3, outer 4, original 3}. Police centre property 0: only the centre is set to 0 and AL = 0 at once; outer, radius, position and original centre keep the caller's values. Police centre 100, outer 20, no radius property, item local 1.0 (empty exemplar: identity curve93, e = 100 x 0.01f = 0.99999998 -> float32 1.0; police has no road factor): AL = 1, centre trunc(100 x 1) = 100, outer 20, radius the stale 250 x 1 = 250, position (1, 2), original centre 100. Fire with no centre property, outer 20, radius 300: centre, outer and radius are zeroed, all three read, the position and original centre := centre (0) written, AL = 0 (centre absent), unscaled: centre 0, outer 20, radius 300, position (5, 6), original 0. With FreeCity4's own callers (a zeroed record, [choice]) the police stale radius is 0. Hand-derived from the 7.1 table and order rules.
